correctness.rationale: The polar dynamics are dr/dt=lambda r(1-r²), dtheta/dt=omega+c(1-r²). For r>0, Phi=theta-(c/lambda)log r has exact derivative omega; r=1 is hyperbolically attracting with radial exponent -2lambda and common orbital frequency omega. Its gradient on the unit circle is e_theta-(c/lambda)e_r; the tangent component is fixed and the radial coefficient arbitrary. Thus all exact cycle data coincide while full phase-response curves differ. Independently simplified the phase derivative symbolically to omega and verified on-cycle shear argument. This is a structural non-identifiability claim, not a numerical failure of any particular ML model.
